reason: Serves the Scalar interactive API documentation UI from the Hono server at /docs behind the session check.
maintenance: Actively maintained by Scalar; the Hono integration is the official adapter for Hono servers.
provenance: Official @scalar/hono-api-reference package, resolved to the exact Bun lockfile artifact and integrity above.
alternatives: Swagger UI Express would require a non-Hono adapter and lacks Scalar's design; @orpc/openapi's bundled reference plugin pulls in @scalar/api-reference as an optional peer and couples the docs route to the oRPC handler rather than keeping it a distinct Hono route.
